about_short_description.short_description: Certus AI uses voice automation to manage restaurant phone calls for orders, reservations, complaints, payments, and POS system integration.

product.name: Certus AI Phone Agent
product.description: A conversational voice AI system for restaurants that answers calls 24/7, takes complex orders, handles reservations and questions, processes payments, and sends orders to the restaurant’s POS or kitchen system.

identifier.value: Certus AI POS and KDS Integration Service

product.name: Certus AI POS and KDS Integration Service
product.description: An implementation service that connects Certus AI to restaurant POS, kitchen display, printer, reservation, and payment systems so calls can result in operationally usable orders and transactions.

product.name: Certus AI Analytics Dashboard
product.description: A reporting interface for monitoring AI-handled restaurant calls, recovered revenue, peak call periods, labor time saved, customer requests, and upsell performance.
